full_page.content:
Page 263 Cont.
Feb. 24th Wn. L. Reno - 63 - Heart & Kidney
24th Walter Prouty - 17 - infantile P. - since 2 ... both legs and right arm. Harold Scott - 9 - infantile paraly. since last September; was getting on nicely till last week he fell and broke his leg.
Mrs. Josephine Strutuski - about 33 - T.B. spots in lungs. Clarence Meldrum - 19 - Serious indigestion - fears appendicitis
25 Bernard Krug - 43 - Kidney, stomach, intestines .... complication - little hope of recovery ...
25 Aeroma Green - 25 - accident with gas and alcohol valve - fumed in his face and his sight is threatened - has wife and child depending on him.
Page 264
Feb. 16 Charles Kaiser - 45 - threatened with serious operation ... going to Hosp. this p.m. - for to-morrow
Thanks - Mrs Irving Emery - 45 - very threaten. operation urged ... prayed - in agony for three days. Astonishingly beautiful light shone - the wall - patient simply forgot she was sick - had been here and Enrolled before
Feb. 26 Mr. & Mrs. Doll here To-night .... Son Stanley .... poorly "What's wanting" - Only Child doctoring now months - tumer removed from brain, mastoid removed, kidnies bad, stomach no good, doctors at witt's end .. Parents acknowledge carelessness in receiving Holy Communion ... promise to wake up and do better ...
27 Mrs. Mary Sikis - 57 - palsey now for 16 yrs. quite helpless always shaking
Baby Joan Kuchta - 7 mo. - beautiful child but sight doubtful ... . Enrolled for two years.
1941, March
March Ist Baby Lind. Opp. - 20 mo. - seems like partially paralysed. .... Salvatore Pianello - 36 - in San. near Montreal
